name: Fairmont Credit Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: $0 introductory annual fee the first year; thereafter $95.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on purchases worldwide.

base_rate.description: 1 point per $1 on all other purchases.

categories.label: Airline tickets purchased directly with airlines

rewards.redemption_notes: Points earned through the Fairmont Rewards program; redeemable for Fairmont stays and rewards.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 2 Complimentary Nights after you make $3,000 in purchases within your first 3 months of account opening.

benefits.title: 1 Complimentary Night Each Anniversary Year
benefits.description: Earn 1 Complimentary Night each anniversary year that you make $12,000 in purchases with your card.

benefits.title: Automatic Upgrade to Premier Status
benefits.description: Automatic upgrade to Fairmont President's Club Premier status after your credit card account is approved.

benefits.title: Earn Platinum Status Faster
benefits.description: When you spend $7,500 on your card, receive a stay credit towards Platinum status, up to a maximum of two stay credits per calendar year.

benefits.title: Annual Fairmont Gold Upgrade Certificate
benefits.description: For existing Premier and Platinum members: annual Fairmont Gold upgrade certificate plus dining certificates as long as you maintain Premier or Platinum membership status earned through stays.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases worldwide.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Automatic upgrade to Premier status on approval; Platinum status acceleration via $7,500 spend stay credits (max 2/year).
other: 1 complimentary night each anniversary year after $12,000 spend
Annual Fairmont Gold upgrade certificate for existing Premier/Platinum members

notes: Applications closed after AccorHotels acquisition. Cards converted to Chase Sapphire Preferred on August 15, 2017.
